title: Broke within 24 hours
text: Broke within 24 hours. I have had more than one Kirby vaccum cleaner over the years and been happy with them all.  I was amazed at this horrible piece of plastic.  It broke with the second use and was on it's way back within days.  In looking it over trying to determine what was wrong I could see stress cracks in the plastic around most screws.  This product, made in China, should not carry the Kirby name.
